state: U.T. Administration of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of the U.T. Administration of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
Applicant must be a registered member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of the U.T.
Applicant must have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
benefits_summary: Provides mid‑day meal and breakfast to registered construction workers at a concessional rate of ₹5 per worker per day.
